newsitem.title: CANADA: Philip makes acquisitions, lines up credit.
newsitem.headline: Philip makes acquisitions, lines up credit.

text.p: Philip Environmental Inc said on Wednesday it has a letter of intent to acquire privately held Luntz Corp and to acquire an alloy plant in Guelph, Ontario, from Alcan Aluminium Ltd.
Philip said the acquisitions will add C$300 million in annual revenue but did not release further details.
Philip also announced it signed an agreement, underwritten by CIBC Wood Gundy, for a four year US$550 million credit facility.

Philip said it would merge Luntz with a wholly-owned Philip unit. Luntz is one of the largest providers of integrated mill services in the United States. With revenues of C$175 million, it produces 1.3 million gross tons of ferrous scrap and 68 million pounds of non-ferrous scrap annually from plants in Ohio and Michigan.
The Alcan recycling plant produces 70,000 tons of foundry alloys, primarlily from aluminum scrap. Closing is expected by November 30. --Reuters Toronto bureau 416-941-8100
